description: Rezones land near Traeger Manor and Terrace to low-density residential.
Allows one to four unit dwellings in the Bright neighbourhood.

chips.text: BDM Enterprises Limited applied for the rezoning.
No public speakers or correspondence were received on this item.

description: Rezones 400 block Cowessess Terrace from R2 to R1B.
Corrects an oversight for specific low-density housing.
Allows homes to front an adjacent municipal reserve.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer commended administration for handling the rezoning oversight.
Dream Asset Management Corporation was not charged application fees.

speakers.name: Darryl Dawson
speakers.organization: Development Review Manager, Community Services Division
speakers.summary: Darryl Dawson, Development Review Manager, Community Services Division, presented the report, displayed a site location map, and expressed the Division's support.
said: Rezoning from R2 to R1B corrects an administrative oversight.
R1B zoning accommodates houses fronting the park, as planned.
The proposed rezoning is consistent with the neighborhood concept plan.

description: Considers rezoning southern Brighton land for residential development.
Changes zoning from FUD to R1A, R1B, R2 districts.
Includes municipal reserve and wetland areas, not for development.

chips.text: Affects residents in the southern Brighton neighbourhood.
Staff confirmed wetlands and parks will not be developed.

description: Sells 1.2 acres of Nutana Kiwanis Park to Elmwood Residences.
Supports Elmwood Community Hub with 42 affordable housing units.
City will offset parkland loss or improve Nutana park spaces.

chips.text: Councillors praised Elmwood's vision for an inclusive community hub.
Sale sets precedent for parkland disposal with significant community benefits.
Public speakers emphasized the hub's importance for accessibility and inclusion.
Project promotes inclusion and accessibility for people with disabilities.
